title: Watchexec polling for a bounded synthetic edit-test loop

synthetic_outcomes.scope: Authored Python/JavaScript assertions in a disposable directory; no private project or session input
synthetic_outcomes.earlier_native_arm: Only the initial check ran; saved edits, burst, assertion failure and recovery were missed. This is a historical comparison, not a simultaneous backend benchmark.
synthetic_outcomes.polling_90s_arm: Every intended changed digest and failure/recovery was detected, but one redundant check occurred during a combined ignored/outside-write phase.
synthetic_outcomes.isolation_45s_arm: Ignored-file creation and a root-directory timestamp change each emitted one directory-only Modify(Metadata(WriteTime)) event. Ignored-file modification and separate outside-root modification/creation caused no checks. Startup was one expected dispatch with no event tags.
synthetic_outcomes.jaq_60s_arm: A filter excluding directory-only events preserved eight intended checks and removed the redundant checks. Shutdown did not complete; bounded owned-process cleanup was required. A separate short diagnostic logged EOF and main-loop completion but still did not exit within12 seconds. No general cause is established.

guard_45s_arm.graceful_exit: Stdin close exited within3 seconds, status0; recorded owned processes and group were absent.

measured_resource_costs.interpretation: Includes the eight synthetic checkers and ten event-wrapper dispatches. Not isolated watcher memory or idle CPU, not a matched throughput benchmark, and not token or human productivity savings.

source_provenance.tested_artifact: Official x86_64 Apple Darwin executable, unsigned; publisher/archive checks were retained in prior provenance receipts
source_provenance.integrity_limit: Digest identity and source provenance are not a complete security audit

conditional_recommendation.use: Opt-in foreground fast checks over an explicit small source root
conditional_recommendation.guard_rule: Run the initial empty dispatch and file/unknown-type events. Skip the expensive checker only when dispatch path tags exist and every path is a known directory. Avoid the tested jaq filter route.
conditional_recommendation.footprint: No global install, daemon, shell-profile change, project wiring, model call or private IPC. Execution permission removed from trial copies after cleanup.

limitations: One synthetic short-run sequence; production and long-term reliability unmeasured
Directory-only events still launch the small command guard
Moving a populated directory may yield only directory tags; run a manual full check after structural changes
Configuration/dependency files require deliberate inclusion in real projects
Same-byte saves, queued slow-job behavior, active-child interruption and full suites untested
Polling does not repair or attribute the original native-event failure
No claim of universal session visibility
privacy_boundary: This draft excludes usernames, absolute machine paths, session identities/content, account/usage information, private logs, process IDs and internal approval history.
